title: Evolve ModelClient contract beyond flattened prompt text
description: The current Agent SDK adapter flattens role messages into one prompt string. Preserve compatibility, but evolve the provider-neutral ModelClient contract so future providers can receive structured messages, tools, response-format hints, profile metadata, and trace metadata.
acceptance_criteria:
- ModelClient input shape preserves structured system/messages.
- Adapter may still flatten internally if needed.
- Contract has a place for tools/response-format/profile/trace metadata.
- Existing mock/model tests are migrated.
- Orchestrator remains provider-neutral.
